units.source_text: 夏季临近，五铺席宽房间的空间，充满了我的又馊又臭的气味。

en.t: As summer drew near, the space of the five-mat room was filled with my sour, stinking odor.

units.source_text: 可笑的是，我是僧侣，而且带有青年人的体具。

en.t: What was ridiculous was that I was a monk, and yet I possessed the body of a young man.

units.source_text: 臭气甚至渗入四个角落上的黑惺惺的大旧柱子和旧板门里。

en.t: The stench even seeped into the large, darkened old pillars in the four corners and into the old wooden doors.

units.source_text: 这些东西经过天长日久，从老朽的木纹缝里散出了小生物的恶臭来。

en.t: Over the long years, these things gave off the foul smell of small living creatures from the cracks in their decayed wood grain.

units.source_text: 这些往子和板门化为半带腥臭味的不动的生物。

en.t: These pillars and wooden doors had turned into motionless creatures that carried a half-fishy, rotten smell.
